headlines.description: Ousmane Dembélé scored a second-half winner as Paris Saint-Germain retained bragging rights in the French capital with a 2-1 win over Paris FC at the Parc des Princes.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG win first Ligue 1 Paris derby since 1978

headlines.description: Ousmane Dembélé put transfer talk behind him and scored a crucial brace for Paris Saint-Germain in a 3-0 win over Lille that returned it to the top of Ligue 1 on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dembélé scores stunning lob in PSG win over Lille

headlines.description: Mason Greenwood continued his hot scoring streak as Marseille kept up the pressure at the top of Ligue 1 with a thumping 5-2 win over Angers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Greenwood scores again in thumping Marseille win

events.name: Le Havre AC at Stade Rennais

headlines.description: Bradley Barcola spared Paris Saint-Germain's blushes as he fired the champions to the top of Ligue 1 in a hard-fought 1-0 victory at lowly Auxerre.
headlines.shortLinkText: Late Barcola strike sends PSG top of Ligue 1

events.name: AS Monaco at Le Havre AC

headlines.description: Nuno Mendes' header sent 10-man Paris Saint-Germain back to the top of Ligue 1 after a hard-fought 2-1 victory at Strasbourg.
headlines.shortLinkText: Late Nuno Mendes header sends 10-man PSG top of Ligue 1

headlines.description: Ousmane Dembélé's double helped Paris Saint-Germain claim a thumping 5-0 victory in their Le Classique meeting with Marseille at the Parc des Princes.
headlines.shortLinkText: 5-star PSG thrash Marseille in Le Classique

headlines.description: Coachless Rennes stunned Ligue 1 leaders Paris Saint-Germain 3-1 at home and snapped a five-game winless run on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG stunned by coachless Rennes in title blow

headlines.description: Désiré Doué set Paris Saint-Germain on their way as they climbed back to the top of Ligue 1 with a regulation 3-0 victory over bottom-of-the-table Metz.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG go back to top of Ligue 1 with win over Metz

events.name: Paris Saint-Germain at Le Havre AC

headlines.description: Bradley Barcola's first-half goal was enough for Paris Saint-Germain to move four points clear at the top of Ligue 1 with a 1-0 win at Le Havre.
headlines.shortLinkText: Barcola sends PSG 4 points clear at top of Ligue 1

headlines.description: Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang struck twice in the final nine minutes as Marseille came from behind to snatch a dramatic 3-2 win over Lyon in Ligue 1.
headlines.shortLinkText: Late Aubameyang goals lead Marseille past Lyon

headlines.description: Paris Saint-Germain dropped points in the Ligue 1 title race after losing 3-1 at home to a slick Monaco side on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Balogun scores as Monaco dent PSG's title hopes

headlines.description: Paris Saint-Germain moved one point clear of Lens at the top of the Ligue 1 table once more with a dominant 4-0 victory over 10-man Nice at the Allianz Riviera.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ex-Barca teen Fernández nets 1st PSG goal in win

events.name: Le Havre AC at Paris FC

headlines.description: Ousmane Dembélé scored twice in the first half as Paris Saint-Germain beat Toulouse 3-1 and increased its lead of Ligue 1 to four points on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dembélé stars as PSG win before Liverpool clash

events.name: AJ Auxerre at Le Havre AC

headlines.description: Folarin Balogun proved decisive for Monaco to extend their winning run in Ligue 1 to seven matches as they earned a 2-1 victory over fellow Champions League chasers Marseille.
headlines.shortLinkText: Balogun fires Monaco to win amid late UCL push

headlines.description: USMNT forward Folarin Balogun scored for the eighth straight league game as Monaco rallied to draw 2-2 with struggling Auxerre in Ligue 1 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: USMNT's Balogun scores in 8th straight for Monaco

headlines.description: Ligue 1 leaders Paris Saint-Germain suffered a shock defeat as Lyon boosted their hopes of playing Champions League football next season with a 2-1 success at Parc des Princes.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG suffer title blow after shock Lyon defeat

headlines.description: Khvicha Kvaratskhelia scored twice as Paris Saint-Germain recovered from its Ligue 1 loss to Lyon with a 3-0 victory over relegation-threatened Nantes on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kvara puts PSG back on track for Ligue 1 title

headlines.description: Gonçalo Ramos was sent off as Paris St Germain went six points clear at the top of Ligue 1 after a 3-0 win at Angers.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG go 6 points clear despite late Ramos red card

headlines.description: Paris Saint-Germain had a stoppage-time penalty ruled out by VAR as they dropped points in their bid to close out a fifth successive Ligue 1 title.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG denied late pen, settle for 2-2 draw vs. Lorient

headlines.description: France star Ousmane Dembele limped off injured less than two weeks before the Champions League final as Paris Saint-Germain suffered a last-gasp 2-1 loss to neighbours Paris FC.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dembélé off injured as PSG fall to neighbours Paris FC

events.name: AS Monaco at Le Havre AC

headlines.description: Paris Saint-Germain scored two goals in stoppage time to draw at Lille 2-2 and record their second consecutive Ligue 1 draw.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG score 2 stoppage-time goals to rescue draw

headlines.description: Paris Saint-Germain 's difficult Ligue 1 start continued as early-season pace-setters AS Monaco won 2-1 at Parc des Princes.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG upset by Monaco to extend winless start

headlines.description: Ferran Torres scored the only goal of the game as Paris Saint-Germain earned their first Ligue 1 win of the season with a 1-0 victory at Brest.
headlines.shortLinkText: Torres strikes again to earn PSG first Ligue 1 win

headlines.description: Paris Saint-Germain closed out a tense 2-1 win over Le Classique rivals Marseille, who finished with 10 men at Stade Velodrome.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG down Marseille, Weah sent off in Le Classique

headlines.description: Paris Saint-Germain continued to put their early-season struggles behind them by beating Le Mans 3-1 to register a third successive Ligue 1 win.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG stroll to third straight league win

headlines.description: Ousmane Dembele inspired a Paris St Germain comeback after coming off the bench to score and contribute an assist in their 3-1 victory at Strasbourg in Ligue 1.
headlines.shortLinkText: USMNT's Reyna scores as Strasbourg beaten by PSG

events.name: AJ Auxerre at Le Havre AC

headlines.description: Senny Mayulu and Mika Godts both came off the bench to score late goals as Paris Saint-Germain moved top of Ligue 1 with a 2-0 win over Lyon on Monday.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG beat Lyon in rescheduled match to top Ligue 1

events.name: Paris Saint-Germain at Le Havre AC

headlines.description: Right back Achraf Hakimi claimed a first career hat-trick and provided two assists as Ligue 1 leaders Paris Saint-Germain came from behind to thrash bottom club Le Havre 5-1.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hakimi hat trick fuels PSG rout of Le Havre

events.name: Le Mans at Le Havre AC
